title: Advanced Grammar and Translation

notes: FRENC 301

title: Phonetics and Oral Proficiency

title: Survey of French Literature

notes: Taught in French. No credit will be given for lower division courses taken after successfully completing any upper division French course taught in French.

title: Survey of French Literature

title: French Civilization
description: French civilization from Middle Ages to the present. Artistic, intellectual achievements and cultural movements.  Course uses language acquisition skills to help students understand cultural differences and develop a global perspective.
notes: Taught in French. No credit will be given for lower division courses taken after successfully completing any upper division French course taught in French.

title: Contemporary France
description: Contemporary France, emphasizing political, economic and social structures as well as artistic, intellectual, and cultural trends.
notes: Taught in French. No credit will be given for lower division courses taken after successfully completing any upper division French course taught in French.

title: Commercial French
description: French commercial practices and language, the enterprise, correspondence, advertising, telecommunications, banking, transportation, import-export, insurance, accounting, stock market, preparation for the Certificate offered by the Paris Chamber of Commerce.
notes: Taught in French. No credit will be given for lower division courses taken after successfully completing any upper division French course taught in French.

title: French Cinema and Theory
description: French cinema emphasizing social, political, and cultural changes in modern France. Topics include film theory, the new wave, history in cinema, influence of feminism, French colonialism, race, class, and gender in modern culture.
notes: Taught in English.

title: Africa in Literature and Film
description: African cultural history through literature and film. Consistency/variety of African cultural expressions and conventions in literature and film.
notes: Taught in English.

title: French Internship
description: Practical work experience in a field related to French and Francophone studies. Work done under joint direction of activity sponsor and instructor.
notes: Approved international internships may count towards international requirement for major. Taught in French. No credit will be given for lower division courses taken after successfully completing any upper division French course taught in French.
